assumptions: This is a unit-size comparison, not market signals or recommended orders.
The $20 risk budget (1%) and $300 unallocated cash reserve are research assumptions, not additional user requirements.
Every price, stop, premium and all-in execution cost in these examples is hypothetical. Public multipliers/margin references are separately identified.
Public initial margin is a dated reference, not verified account buying power; fees, margin changes, minimum account equity and liquidation buffers still need verification.
Each row is an alternative standalone proposal. No simultaneous portfolio or target return is inferred.
All verification flags remain false; none of these rows authorizes execution.

limitations: A planned stop loss is not a maximum loss; gaps and failed exits can exceed it.
Capital inputs require full margin, premium, funding and liquidity-buffer treatment upstream.
Flags are caller declarations; this tool does not verify evidence, buying power, or account state.
Portfolio risk and latched drawdown pauses must limit the supplied risk budget upstream.
Independent alternatives must not be summed into a simultaneous portfolio.
No return estimate, fill simulation, or brokerage order is produced.
